propositions: The REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable, deprecated in v0.11.0, must be fully removed from the resolver and all code paths.
A tombstone registry entry with fail-loud behavior (RemovedInputError) must be added to prevent silent model resolution changes when the env var is still set.
All references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL in source code, tests, and operator-facing documentation must be removed or reworded to past tense.
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model, CLI override -c llm.model, and per-step workflow model: override must continue to function as the surviving model resolution channels.
Test suite must be retargeted to use surviving config channels instead of the removed env var, ensuring no test sets REBAR_LLM_MODEL and builds an LLMConfig.
Generated documentation (docs/env-vars.md) must be regenerated to exclude the removed variable, and all hand-written docs and infra material must be updated.
